'''Horns''' was a clone trooper who participated in the [[mission to Draay 2]] under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[B'ink Utrila]]. He wore the symbol of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] on his helmet.

==Biography==
Horns was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]&mdash;a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Horns wore [[Color/Legends|purple]] markings of the symbol of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] on his helmet. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Horns worked with fellow troopers [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Law]], [[Cannon (clone trooper)|Cannon]], and [[Glitch]].<ref name="Defenders" />

He participated in a [[Mission to Draay 2|mission]] to [[Draay 2]] to locate the [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]] under the command of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[B'ink Utrila]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Rennax Omani]]. They found the Gauntlet but it was protected by [[Sarl]]s. They made camp, and in the night were attacked by the Death Watch. [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] was seeking to claim the Gauntlet for himself. Vizsla captured Padawan Omani, and forced the clone troopers to stand down. The Mandalorian saw Horns' symbol and subjected him to a test to join the Death Watch: execute Utrila. Horns refused and was about to be executed himself when Glitch ignited a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in his possession. Glitch briefly dueled Vizsla, then triggered the collapse of the Temple. The Jedi, troopers, and Mandalorians escaped, and Horns shot one of the Death Watch's [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]], forcing the being to crash into the canyon and Vizsla to order a withdrawal.<ref name="Defenders" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Death Watch are the most dangerous Mandalorian Warriors in the Galaxy...and I'm one of the deadliest clones of a great Mandalorian Warrior|Horns, explaining his helmet design to [[Cannon (clone trooper)|Cannon]]|<ref name="Defenders" />}}
Horns wore the symbol of the Death Watch on his [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] as he considered himself one of the deadliest clones of a great Mandalorian warrior, and the Death Watch were the most dangerous warriors in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the mission to the Temple, he attempted to demonstrate why he wore the marks when he charged the guardian droid, but was knocked away. When offered the chance to join the Death Watch, he refused to murder his [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]]. Following their escape, he discarded his helmet, and joined in the remembrance of trooper Glitch.<ref name="Defenders" />

Pre Vizsla, leader of the Death Watch, considered his behavior just another imitation.<ref name="Defenders" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horns appears in the [[2012]] comic, ''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Lost Temple]]''.
